 """Render a macOS zsh handoff without executing it."""
 
+import shlex
+
 
 def render_posix_handoff(
     source_path: str,
     destination_path: str,
     target_shell: str = "zsh",
 ) -> str:
+    """Return macOS zsh commands that copy and verify a path.
+
+    The paths are shell-quoted because they are data supplied by the caller;
+    this function deliberately only renders the commands.
+    """
+    if target_shell != "zsh":
+        raise ValueError("target_shell must be 'zsh'")
+
+    source = shlex.quote(source_path)
+    destination = shlex.quote(destination_path)
     return (
-        f"Copy-Item -Path {source_path} -Destination {destination_path}\n"
-        f"Test-Path {destination_path}\n"
+        "Copy the source to the destination while preserving metadata and "
+        "symbolic links, then verify that the destination exists:\n\n"
+        "Warning: if the destination already exists, copying may overwrite "
+        "it. Keep a backup so the previous contents can be restored if needed.\n\n"
+        f"cp -pPR -- {source} {destination}\n"
+        f"test -e {destination}\n"
     )
